STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_11511_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_11511_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_11511 (
  clk,
  reset,

  mm_response_readdata,
  mm_response_read,
  mm_response_address,
  mm_response_byteenable,
  mm_response_waitrequest,

  src_response_data,
  src_response_valid,
  src_response_ready,

  sw_reset,
  response_watermark,
  response_fifo_full,
  response_fifo_empty,
  done_strobe,
  actual_bytes_transferred,
  error,
  early_termination,
  transfer_complete_IRQ_mask,
  error_IRQ_mask,
  early_termination_IRQ_mask,
  descriptor_buffer_full
);

parameter RESPONSE_PORT = 0;   
parameter FIFO_DEPTH = 256;    
parameter FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2 = 8;
localparam FIFO_WIDTH = (RESPONSE_PORT == 0)? 41 : 51;  

input clk;
input reset;

output [31:0] mm_response_readdata;
input mm_response_read;
input mm_response_address;  
input [3:0] mm_response_byteenable;
output mm_response_waitrequest;

output [255:0] src_response_data;  
output src_response_valid;
input src_response_ready;

input sw_reset;
output [15:0] response_watermark;
output response_fifo_full;
output response_fifo_empty;
input done_strobe;
input [31:0] actual_bytes_transferred;
input [7:0] error;
input early_termination;
  
input transfer_complete_IRQ_mask;
input [7:0] error_IRQ_mask;
input early_termination_IRQ_mask;
input descriptor_buffer_full;  

reg [FIFO_WIDTH-1:0] fifo_mem [FIFO_DEPTH-1:0];
reg [FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2-1:0] fifo_head;
reg [FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2-1:0] fifo_tail;
reg [FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2:0] fifo_count;

wire [FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2-1:0] fifo_used;
wire fifo_full;
wire fifo_empty;
reg [FIFO_WIDTH-1:0] fifo_output;

assign fifo_used = fifo_count;
assign fifo_full = (fifo_count == FIFO_DEPTH);
assign fifo_empty = (fifo_count == 0);


generate
  if (RESPONSE_PORT == 0)
  begin
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset)
    begin
      if (reset)
      begin
        fifo_head <= 0;
        fifo_tail <= 0;
        fifo_count <= 0;
      end
      else if (sw_reset)
      begin
        fifo_head <= 0;
        fifo_tail <= 0;
        fifo_count <= 0;
      end
      else
      begin
        if (done_strobe && !fifo_full)
        begin
          fifo_mem[fifo_head] <= {early_termination, error, actual_bytes_transferred};
          fifo_head <= fifo_head + 1;
          fifo_count <= fifo_count + 1;
        end
        if (fifo_read && !fifo_empty)
        begin
          fifo_output <= fifo_mem[fifo_tail];
          fifo_tail <= fifo_tail + 1;
          fifo_count <= fifo_count - 1;
        end
      end
    end

    wire fifo_read;
    assign fifo_read = (mm_response_read == 1) & (fifo_empty == 0) & (mm_response_address == 1) & (mm_response_byteenable[3] == 1);

    assign mm_response_readdata = (mm_response_address == 0) ? fifo_output[31:0] : {{23{1'b0}}, fifo_output[40:32]};
    assign mm_response_waitrequest = fifo_empty;
    assign response_watermark = {{(16-(FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2+1)){1'b0}}, fifo_full, fifo_used};  
    assign response_fifo_full = fifo_full;
    assign response_fifo_empty = fifo_empty;

    assign src_response_data = 0;
    assign src_response_valid = 0;
  end
  else if (RESPONSE_PORT == 1)
  begin
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset)
    begin
      if (reset)
      begin
        fifo_head <= 0;
        fifo_tail <= 0;
        fifo_count <= 0;
      end
      else if (sw_reset)
      begin
        fifo_head <= 0;
        fifo_tail <= 0;
        fifo_count <= 0;
      end
      else
      begin
        if (done_strobe && !fifo_full)
        begin
          fifo_mem[fifo_head] <= {early_termination_IRQ_mask, error_IRQ_mask, transfer_complete_IRQ_mask, early_termination, error, actual_bytes_transferred};
          fifo_head <= fifo_head + 1;
          fifo_count <= fifo_count + 1;
        end
        if (fifo_read && !fifo_empty)
        begin
          fifo_output <= fifo_mem[fifo_tail];
          fifo_tail <= fifo_tail + 1;
          fifo_count <= fifo_count - 1;
        end
      end
    end

    wire fifo_read;
    assign fifo_read = (fifo_empty == 0) & (src_response_ready == 1);

    assign src_response_data = {{204{1'b0}}, descriptor_buffer_full, fifo_output};
    assign src_response_valid = (fifo_empty == 0);
    assign response_watermark = {{(16-(FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2+1)){1'b0}}, fifo_full, fifo_used};  
    assign response_fifo_full = fifo_full;
    assign response_fifo_empty = fifo_empty;

    assign mm_response_readdata = 0;
    assign mm_response_waitrequest = 0;
  end
  else
  begin
    assign mm_response_readdata = 0;
    assign mm_response_waitrequest = 0;
    assign src_response_data = 0;
    assign src_response_valid = 0;
    assign response_watermark = 0;
    assign response_fifo_full = 0;
    assign response_fifo_empty = 0;
  end
endgenerate

endmodule

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_11511.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
